pages.text: While worn, this charm grants Haste I for five seconds when you have no Haste effect. It checks once per second and does not replace stronger Haste. No magic power is needed.

Mining Coal, Diamond, Emerald, Lapis, Salt, Amethyst, Garnet or Opal Ore without Silk Touch can add one item to each drop stack, with a separate 50 percent chance. Fortune enchantments still apply. Silver, Redstone and Quartz are not included.

Obtain this Charm-slot accessory from a master Hedge Witch's random accessory pool. The base offer costs 8-16 emeralds for one accessory; a particular merchant need not select it. There is no crafting recipe. Wear it in a Charm or general Curio slot.
